work_completed: AGENT-LOOP-003 F0 (Fusion side), per Joshua's 2026-10-28 decisions: new src/fusion/agent_loop_registry.py. AgentRegistry is an explicit agentId -> pair registry keyed by the avatar's roster id. build_default_registry() creates the StayAlert pair from its roster configs (stay_alert_001 / stay_alert_aide_001), bound through SessionOrchestrator. The HTTP endpoint answers 404 with no intent for any unregistered agentId, before the decision source is called; Fusion never creates an avatar on demand. Constructing the pair writes nothing to disk.

AGENT-LOOP-003 F1: new src/fusion/agent_loop_memory.py. StatefulAgentLoopDecision wraps a decision source and keeps, per agentId, a bounded history (default 8) of tick, scene id, verb, target and outcome. The wrapped source is called as decide(observation, history); ignore_history adapts stateless sources. It plugs into FusionAgentLoop(decide=...) unchanged. Calls for one agent are serialized (one writer per agent); different agents run concurrently.

Outcome source verified and recorded (OUTCOME_SOURCE = 'next_perception'): the engine's accepted/rejected results never reach Fusion over the HTTP transport (Fusion has only POST /agent-loop/perception; Godot's FusionHttpLink.cs logs the result locally). Outcome = horizontal movement, scene change, target still visible, distance to target before/after, target taken by someone else. The engine never reports an agent's own anchor as occupied, so its own sit/use is not visible via occupied.
Edge cases: an intent that fails validation is not remembered; a repeated tick drops the pending decision without an outcome; a tick that goes backwards (engine restart) clears that agent's history.

agent_loop_http.build_decision_source() now wraps the GGUF or fallback source in StatefulAgentLoopDecision (FUSION_AGENT_LOOP_HISTORY sets the size). Decisions are unchanged: both sources ignore the history until F2/F3.
The brief is now in the repo at docs/specs/AGENT-LOOP-003-fusion-state-and-goals-brief.md, sections 0-6 verbatim, plus §7, an addendum of facts verified against the code.
Joshua's decisions recorded as brief §8 (narrow wait; split acceptance 4 into 4a/4b; F0 agentId binding; order F0 -> F5).
